title: Saul Doesn’t Wait
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who knows how to pause, and tonight Saul could not wait seven days: Wren waits for the cookies to finish baking and learns that the waiting is what makes them good.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Wren knows how to pause, and pausing is the heart of waiting. In Wren’s world today: she and Dad are baking cookies, and they smell SO good. Wren wants to open the oven right now. Dad says, “Ten more minutes.” Wren taps her foot. Then she sits down by the oven window and watches the cookies puff up and turn golden, one minute at a time. When the timer dings, they are perfect. Just like Saul at Gilgal should have done, Wren learned that waiting is part of how good things are made.
